name: supply-sophie-unanswered-round
narrative: Sophie runs RUTF procurement for the Connect-RUTF program. 17 days ago she asked six suppliers to quote round 2: half have never answered, despite two reminders, and she forwards whatever does arrive to an AI that records it. Sophie opens round 2 and reads who answered and who has said nothing, how long each has been silent and when she last chased them, and that the round has not yet settled how import duties are handled. She opens the reminder drafted for Sahel, which says when Sahel was asked and last reminded, and records today's chase from the draft itself. Sahel answers with a quote; Sophie forwards it, and in the round's history, turned to replies only, Sahel's email comes first: she opens it beside what the AI recorded from it, the reply dated the day it came in. On the comparison only Harmattan's quote can be compared on landed total: Kanem's has not stated how many sachets are in a carton, and Sahel's gives no freight figure, no duty figure and no exchange rate, while the round's duty terms are still not settled. Northgate's questions are waiting on her, and she answers the one about who imports: we import, under the program's duty waiver. She marks that answer as the round's import duty terms and opens the comparison again: Sahel's quote, which leaves duty out, now reads duty waived, the round's terms set from her answer to Northgate. Importing makes the paperwork hers, and round 1 shows what that means: its 2,000 cartons are still not in Kano, and on the order with Harmattan, the forwarder's message says the trucks are held at the border on our import permit, so the order reads as waiting on us, and Harmattan's invoice is flagged above the agreed price, billed against agreed. Back on her overview, Sophie reads who is still silent, Sahel's quote now short only its exchange rate and freight, its duty covered by the waiver, and whose move each thing is, the round 1 order waiting on her to provide the import permit and to dispute Harmattan's invoice above the agreed price.

sophie.intro: Sophie buys RUTF for the Connect-RUTF program; suppliers and the freight forwarder email her, and she forwards what they send to an AI that records it.
sophie.name: Sophie

scenes.narrative: Sophie asked six suppliers to quote round 2; only three of the six have replied, though she chased the others twice. She opens the round and reads who answered and who is silent, how long each has been silent and when she last chased them, and that the round has not settled how import duties are handled. She wants the record to keep telling her the truth: what the answers left out, and whose move it is.
scenes.title: Half the round never answered

features.description: The drafts panel lists a Reminder draft for each of the three silent suppliers.
features.verify: Playwright: #drafts contains 3 drafts labelled 'Reminder', one for Sahel Nutrition Industries

features.description: Each reminder draft says when the supplier was asked and last reminded.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's draft [data-testid=draft-why] contains 'no reply is recorded' and 'last reminded on'

features.description: A reminder draft carries a Chased on date, defaulting to today, and a Record chase button that saves last_reminder_on and returns to the round with Sahel's Last chased cell marked.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's draft shows [data-testid=chase-date] and a 'Record chase' button; after clicking it, tr[data-changed] is Sahel Nutrition Industries' row

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the round's draft emails and reads the reminder drafted for Sahel: it says when Sahel was asked and when she last reminded them, and under the message the Chased on field already holds today's date beside Record chase, so the chase she sends is recorded from the draft itself.
scenes.title: She chases Sahel from a drafted reminder

features.description: Between scenes 2 and 3 the AI records Sahel's emailed quote and reply over the labs MCP with source ref, excerpt and sender.
features.verify: Django shell: the program's newest OperationCall rows are quote_record and outreach_update on channel 'mcp' with source_sender 'Amadou Issoufou, Sahel Nutrition Industries'

features.description: The round's history opens with a Replies only toggle applied, showing just the entries recorded from an email, Sahel's first.
features.verify: Playwright: after clicking [data-testid=history-replies-only], no 'Last chased' bookkeeping line is visible and Sahel's email event is first

features.description: Each email event shows the sender, the AI recorder and the excerpt behind one Source email toggle.
features.verify: Playwright: Sahel's email event, opened, shows 'Amadou Issoufou, Sahel Nutrition Industries' and an excerpt containing 'EUR 0.31 per sachet'

scenes.narrative: Sahel answers the reminder with a quote and Sophie forwards it to the AI. She lands on the round's history, turned to replies only, where Sahel's email comes first. She opens Sahel's own email and reads who wrote it, the excerpt of what Sahel wrote, and below it what the AI recorded from it, the reply dated the day it came in, so she can check the record against Sahel's words.
scenes.title: Sahel finally answers, and she opens the email

features.description: The comparison page compares Harmattan's quote on landed total and names what blocks the others: sachets per carton on Kanem's; the exchange rate, the freight amount and the duties amount on Sahel's.
features.verify: Playwright: /compare/ reads '1 of 3 quotes can be compared on landed total'; Harmattan Therapeutics is under Comparable with a landed total; the Kanem Foods Ltd card shows 'Blocking: Sachets per carton not stated on the quote'; the Sahel Nutrition Industries card shows 'Quote is in EUR and no exchange rate was recorded', 'Freight excluded from the quote but no freight amount recorded' and 'Duties excluded from the quote but no duties amount recorded', and no quantity mismatch

features.description: A one-line note at the top of the comparison states the round's import duty terms and what they mean for quotes that leave duty out.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=comparison-duty-terms] reads 'Import duties for this round: not settled'

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the comparison and reads what each answer still lacks: only Harmattan's quote can be compared on landed total, Kanem's has not stated how many sachets are in a carton, and Sahel's new quote gives no freight figure, no duty figure and no exchange rate, while the round's duty terms are not settled, so its landed cost can't be worked out yet.
scenes.title: An answer is not yet a quote she can compare

features.description: The What we owe them section lists Northgate's open questions with raised day and text.
features.verify: Playwright: #owed shows 3 rows under 'Northgate Commodities' with '3 questions', each reading how many days it has been open

features.description: The Mark answered form carries a select [data-testid=answer-duty-terms] (name duty_terms), labelled 'This answer sets the round's import duty terms'; submitting with a value records the answer and sets the tender's duty terms as an attributed operation with a Revision.
features.verify: Playwright: the resolve form shows 'This answer sets the round's import duty terms'; after choosing buyer_waiver and Save, the importer question's answer reads 'We import, under the program's duty waiver; please state freight to Kano.'

features.description: After the answer sets the round's duty terms, the comparison's duty terms note reads the waiver, and a blocked quote that leaves duty out has its own Duty line reading duty waived (our import) and citing the answer that set the terms, with duty no longer among its blockers.
features.verify: Playwright: [data-testid=comparison-duty-terms] contains 'we import, under the program's duty waiver'; Sahel Nutrition Industries' Needs info card [data-testid=card-duty] contains 'Duty waived (our import)' and 'from your answer to Northgate Commodities', and its blockers do not include 'Duties excluded from the quote but no duties amount recorded'

scenes.narrative: Back on the round, Sophie answers Northgate's question about who imports, for her reply to Northgate: we import, under the program's duty waiver. She marks that answer as setting the round's import duty terms, then opens the round's comparison again: Sahel's quote, which leaves duty out, now reads duty waived (our import), the round's terms set from her answer to Northgate, and duty is no longer among what blocks it.
scenes.title: One answer to Northgate settles how duty is costed

scenes.narrative: Importing makes the paperwork hers, and round 1 shows what that means: its 2,000 cartons are still not in Kano. On the order with Harmattan, the order says it is waiting on us for the import permit, and the forwarder's message in its history says the trucks are held at the border until it is lodged; and Harmattan's invoice is flagged above the agreed price, billed against agreed.
scenes.title: Round 1's order: held on our permit, billed high
